resources.string: Open %1$s → %2$s while reading to save your place with an optional note.
Open %1$s → %2$s in a book to return to passages you’ve highlighted.
All your catalogs, on every device
Save several catalogs in %1$s → %2$s and switch between them while browsing. Signed in to Quire, the list follows you to your other devices.

Books with a file name for a title, or no cover, author or description, now get their details from Open Library or tidied by AI, with a label saying which. It runs on Wi-Fi, up to 25 books a day. Turn it off in %1$s → %2$s, or go back to a book’s original details from its menu.

Share a PDF with Quire, or add one with + in the library, and your Quire server converts it to an EPUB in your library. It’s converted on your own server and sent nowhere else. Follow it in %1$s → %2$s in the library.
Switch on alerts for new books in your catalogs, a daily reading reminder, or Do Not Disturb while a book is open, in %1$s → %2$s. All three stay off until you turn them on.
Add a free, legal catalog of classics with one tap in %1$s → %2$s, or from the Catalog tab when you have none yet. Those in your language come first.

Quire now counts how long, when and how fast you read. It is kept on this device and in your phone’s own backup, never sent to Quire’s server or to AI. See your streaks, your speed and how long a book has left in the library under %1$s → %2$s. You can turn it off in Settings.
In a book’s %1$s → %2$s, see each change beside the current details, keep the ones you want, and choose the cover: the book’s own, one from Open Library, or one drawn by Quire.
In a book’s %1$s → %2$s, choose %3$s, pick a few passages and ask what connects them. The AI on your Quire server answers in a few lines you can share as a note. Nothing of the conversation is saved.
All your statistics in one place

Library stats and reading statistics are now one screen, in %1$s → %2$s in the library. Your library’s counts, top authors and themes sit beside your reading time, streaks and speed, and stay there even with recording off.
